environments.name: 春泽桥前竹木密林道空景
environments.body_en: An empty old cart road winding through dense bamboo interwoven with tall dark woodland trees, wet winter foliage arching overhead. A broad passing bay at the bend, muddy wheel ruts, shallow puddles and scattered bamboo leaves, continuous walkable ground beside the cart track. The road leads toward a distant forest opening; the stone bridge beyond remains hidden by the bend and vegetation. Rainy night, cool diffuse light through canopy gaps, irregular leaf shadows, deep green and charcoal tones, readable ground and layered trunks. Live-action Chinese costume drama set, no people, no vehicles, no lanterns, no visible bridge deck. A separate empty roadside holding verge beside the passing bay has room for eight unmounted horses, outside the ground-action space; no horses present in this empty set study.
environments.checks: 竹丛与高树密集，道弯宽段可供一车与护送人员活动；前方林口通桥，主战区不出现桥面或护栏；空底仅冷夜光，车灯在人车绑定时加入；不生世隙，不把九人合成一体 宽段与外缘避让空地分开，能容车、十匹马和地面动作；无人空底不生成马。 车道需容双马并排牵引，不只容单马车宽；另八匹坐骑的外缘避让区不并入两匹牵引马位置。

environments.name: 南街汤摊与街口
environments.body_en: An ordinary street in a fictional Chinese capital, layered timber shopfronts, a small covered soup stall beside a continuous walkway, a steaming pot and bowls under warm practical stall lanterns, damp stone paving, cool rainy night beyond the awning. Empty of identifiable people, lived-in rather than a palace avenue.
environments.checks: 摊位不堵全街；顾府、短墙与西巷相接另由人工平面图锁定

environments.name: 顾府外院
environments.body_en: An old Chinese family courtyard seen from its south gate toward the north reception hall, west guest-room doors facing the open courtyard, east and west covered passages. Faded dark-red gate paint, refined weathered timber, blue-gray stone paving, a rain-catching basin kept beside a wall, no central pool. Cool overcast morning through the open sky, soft reflected light from pale plaster, empty walkable center. An empty temporary horse-holding space runs along the outer wall outside the west lodging wing, clear of all doors and the side passage, with room for eight horses; no animals present.
environments.checks: 南正门北前厅、西厢临外院；无中央水池，无额外秘道 西厢室外沿墙预留八匹马空地，入口和西侧道不堵；空景不画马，卧具区不改马厩。

environments.name: 前厅固定大案
environments.body_en: A modest old Chinese reception hall facing south into an open courtyard, a fixed large wooden table in the hall and a separate small portable table beside its doorway, east passage toward a study, west passage toward a bedroom. Fine repaired timber joinery, faded paint and a rain basin in one corner, overcast morning light from the south opening.
environments.checks: 固定大案与可移动小案分开，真票在内、来人隔门

environments.name: 外院西厢
environments.body_en: A practical west guest room opening east onto an old Chinese courtyard, folded temporary bedding, separate personal travel bags along the inner wall, a low bench and plain iron cooking pot. Neatly used timber and cotton, soft cool morning light from the open east-facing door, empty room with a clear passage to the courtyard.
environments.checks: 是九卒临住处，不是外库；九套铺盖与包后期逐件摆，不靠MJ数数

environments.name: 书房
environments.body_en: A small old Chinese study, an inward-bolted wooden door to the corridor, a paper lattice window facing the inner courtyard with a low wooden cabinet directly beneath it, a desk and a plain standing bronze mirror on the desk. Warm oil lamp on the desk, weak cool night light through the paper window, polished aged timber, empty room, no symbols or altar.
environments.checks: 窗朝府内、窗下柜、门内闩、铜镜案灯位置可复现；无祭坛、暗门光

environments.name: 卧房
environments.body_en: A small Chinese bedroom separate from the study, a plain wooden bed against the inner wall, low bedside table, cloth screen and clear access from the corridor door. A sheltered oil lamp lights the bed gently, cool night ambience at a paper window, warm-gray bedding and repaired fine timber, no mirror or broken cup.
environments.checks: 与书房分房；不复制碎杯、铜镜、松窗闩

environments.name: 后院井边

Damp gray paving, plain wooden water bucket, cool overcast morning with soft sky reflections in the basin, empty safe walkway.
